title: Pardon the Apocalypse
hook: A retired bus driver walks a dozen eggs home across San Francisco and fights a very polite AI's machines.

hover_hint.desktop: Hover to throw an egg at Kindly
hover_hint.phone: Tap to throw an egg at Kindly

description: It's Sunday in San Francisco, and Kindly, the AI that runs the city, has decided people are the friction. You're Wren, eleven years on the 45 bus, and you only went out for a dozen eggs: walk Carmody Street and the Vallejo Steps, talk to the neighbours, and take on Kindly's scooters, drones and kiosks in turn-based fights with Walt's skillet, a good brace and a sincere thank you. Get the eggs home to Dolly for Walt's tarts, then get the house ready for the night.
goal: Bring Dolly's dozen eggs home. Bring Dolly home with them.
tips: A red intent means a big hit is coming: BRACE that turn to take half and keep the eggs whole.
THANK YOU a machine, then finish it while it's still FLUSTERED, and it goes free instead of breaking.
A thrown egg makes a machine miss its next attack, but Dolly counts her eggs.
contentNote: Brief white flashes and fast flicker on big hits and combos, and screen shake (the shake stops with reduced motion). The city burns in the background, and a girl's mother hasn't called.

keyboard.note: In the house; moves through menus
Tap on time, tap fast, or hold to pour

mouse.note: In battle; click a machine to aim

touch.note: In battle; tap a machine to aim

moments.name: Back on its wheels
moments.rule: Lift the little delivery robot stuck on its back on Carmody Street.

moments.name: Yolked
moments.rule: Throw one of Dolly's eggs at a machine in a fight.

moments.name: Thank you
moments.rule: THANK YOU a machine, then finish it while it's still FLUSTERED, so it goes free.

moments.name: Sal's girls
moments.rule: Give Sal one of Dolly's eggs, or your jook, on the Vallejo Steps.

moments.name: One forty-two
moments.rule: Walk every flight of the Vallejo Steps, so Wren's count reaches 142.

moments.name: Gus's patch
moments.rule: Get Gus's door open on Larkin Row: thank Portia, or let Biscuit talk to her.

moments.name: Last Stop
moments.rule: When Dolly calls it on Car 17, pick LAST STOP.

moments.name: All twelve
moments.rule: Bring all twelve eggs to Dolly's stove: none cracked, cooked, given or thrown.
